description: Combat Veteran, Former Prosecutor & Lifelong Resident Asks Voters for the Opportunity to Serve Spartanburg, SC – Travis Moore, a local attorney and combat veteran, announced his candidacy today for South Carolina State House District 33. Moore will file this afternoon at the Spartanburg Board of Elections to run in the June 9 Republican Primary …
